daf-externalisee.title: Outsourced Administrative and Financial Management (DAF-X™)
daf-externalisee.summary: When leadership spends a growing share of its time on finance — treasury, reporting, budgets, tax controls — at the expense of core business, or when visibility over cash flow, margins and runway becomes insufficient, bringing in an outsourced CFO changes everything: it clarifies, structures, forecasts and secures.
offerings: Cash flow and margin management
Monthly financial reporting and dashboards
Budget structuring and forecasting
Securing banking and tax relationships
daf-externalisee.target: SMEs with 300M to 5Bn FCFA in revenue, subsidiaries, growing groups

audit-controle-interne.title: Audit & Internal Control
audit-controle-interne.summary: Risk assessment, process improvement, regulatory compliance and independent assurance over the reliability of your internal processes.
offerings: Accounting & financial audit: regularity, fair presentation, SYSCOHADA compliance
Internal audit & control: risk mapping, prioritized action plan
Financial due diligence: mergers & acquisitions, investment, financing
Treasury and regulatory compliance audit (COBAC, CIMA, DGI, CNPS, OHADA)
audit-controle-interne.fee: Quoted individually, based on engagement scope

highlight.title: Focus: bank overcharge audit and recovery
highlight.description: Credit institutions apply complex calculation mechanisms for overdraft interest, commissions and various fees. Value-date errors, double billing, non-contractual fees: these anomalies typically represent between 0.5% and 3% of annual banking flow volumes.
highlight.note: Success fee: 10% (excl. tax) on amounts actually recovered. No upfront fixed fee, no fee at all if no reimbursement is obtained.

conseil-fiscal.title: Tax Advisory & Optimization
conseil-fiscal.summary: Comprehensive tax support, from day-to-day compliance to structural group-level optimization.
offerings: Day-to-day taxation: corporate tax, VAT, dividend withholding, service withholding, business license, registration duties
Tax optimization and group tax restructuring
Tax disputes: support during tax authority audits, defense briefs
Transfer pricing and international taxation
conseil-fiscal.fee: Quoted individually, based on engagement scope

financement-bancaire.title: Bank Financing
financement-bancaire.summary: From assessing your borrowing capacity through to negotiation, we secure access to your financing.
offerings: Assessment of borrowing capacity and bankability
Business plan development, credit file structuring, selection of partner banks
Alternative financing: private equity, IFC, AFD, BDEAC, FMO

restructuration-financiere.title: Financial Restructuring & Turnaround
restructuration-financiere.summary: In the face of financial distress, we act quickly to stabilize, restructure and turn the business around.
offerings: Liquidity diagnosis and emergency cash flow plan
Debt restructuring and group reorganization
OHADA preventive insolvency procedures
restructuration-financiere.fee: Quoted individually, based on engagement scope

conception-suivi-business-plans.navDescription: Design and implementation follow-up of your business plans
conception-suivi-business-plans.title: Business Plan Design and Implementation Support
conception-suivi-business-plans.summary: We support project owners in designing solid, bankable business plans, as well as in the rigorous follow-up of their operational implementation through to the achievement of set objectives.
offerings: Business plan design and structuring (assumptions, financial projections, financing plan)
Support in presenting the project to financial partners
Periodic monitoring of implementation and performance indicators
Adjustments and recommendations during project execution
conception-suivi-business-plans.fee: Quoted individually, based on engagement scope

meta.title: FAQ | Trust Consulting Partners
meta.description: Answers to frequently asked questions about our engagements, fees and methodology.

items.question: Is the flash assessment really free?
items.answer: Yes. All our engagements begin with a free flash assessment lasting about 2 hours: a meeting with the executive followed by a financial, tax and organizational evaluation, with a recommendation note provided. No commitment is required at this stage.

items.question: In which countries do you operate?
items.answer: We operate in Cameroon (headquartered in Yaoundé), Gabon, Congo-Brazzaville and Côte d'Ivoire — the entire CEMAC/WAEMU region.

items.question: How are your fees determined?
items.answer: It depends on the nature of the engagement: monthly subscription engagements are billed as a flat fee payable at the start of the month, one-off engagements follow a two-stage payment (40% upon signing the engagement letter, 60% upon delivery), and financing engagements combine a monthly retainer with a success fee on the amount obtained.

items.question: What happens if no bank overcharge is identified during an audit?
items.answer: No fee is charged if there is no result. Our compensation model for this engagement is entirely aligned with results obtained: 10% (excl. tax) on amounts actually recovered, with no upfront fixed fee.

items.question: How long does a bank audit engagement take?
items.answer: The audit and diagnostic phase usually takes 3 to 6 weeks. The claims and recovery phase can take 2 to 6 months depending on banks' response times. The final recommendations phase takes 2 to 3 weeks.

items.question: How does contract termination work?
items.answer: Monthly subscription engagements may be terminated with one month's notice. Fixed-term engagements cannot be terminated unilaterally, except in the case of serious misconduct.

items.question: Is my financial information kept confidential?
items.answer: Yes. We are contractually committed to maintaining strict confidentiality of the information shared, with a signed confidentiality agreement for each engagement.

items.question: How do I book an appointment with you?
items.answer: The easiest way is to use our contact form, call us directly, or write to us by email or WhatsApp. We respond within 24 business hours.
